_comment: Copy this file, fill it in from the campaign book, and import it in the app
(Campaign tab, + button). It is validated on import and every problem is
Keep your filled-in copy OFF this repository: setup instructions and flavour
text are Fantasy Flight's words. .gitignore already blocks *.campaign.json.
Everything below marked TODO needs your input. See QUESTIONNAIRE.md for what
each one is asking for. Keys beginning with an underscore are comments and
Card and set codes are MarvelCDB codes. You can find them in the app: the
card detail screen shows the pack, and the code is in the MarvelCDB URL.
_counters: Numbers the campaign tracks. scope 'hero' means each player has their own.

counters._note: maxFrom reads printed health from the card database, so you do not restate it.

_flagSets: Yes/no facts remembered between scenarios. scope 'perScenario' gives one per scenario, which conditions can count.
_cardLists: Lists of card codes the campaign records.
_market: Cards buyable between scenarios. One copy of each per campaign across the whole group.

flavour.fr: TODO: the flavour text read at the start.

scenarios._baseSetup: What goes on the table. Codes, not prose.
scenarios._campaignSetup: Extra instructions, in order. 'when' hides a step unless it applies. 'action' turns it into a button that changes state.

text.fr: TODO: an instruction that always applies.
TODO: an instruction conditional on an earlier scenario.
TODO: something a player may choose to do.

onVictory._prompts: What the app asks after a win. Types: number, boolean, perHeroNumber, perHeroBoolean, cardList, choice.

label.fr: TODO: a yes/no about the final board state?

prompts._note: Keep this id exactly. The engine skips eliminated heroes in per-hero rewards.

onVictory._effects: Applied in order. Several small steps rather than one formula. 'max' caps that step only.
onVictory._next: Evaluated in order, first match wins. A branch is a condition, never code.
